purpose: View-aligned guides for Blender projection baking; not renders of the delivered mesh

prompts.front: Create a precise FRONT VIEW texture-painting guide for a 3D character. The FIRST image is the ACTUAL 3D mesh render and is an absolute geometry/camera constraint. Keep its full-body silhouette, limb positions, hands, feet, head size and location, hair mass, garment hem, armor plates, belt, straps, and all major folds in exactly the same image positions. Do not redesign or move the mesh. The SECOND image is the desired art reference: match its mature handsome swordsman face, fine black stubble rather than a solid black beard, expressive sharply defined eyes and eyebrows, near-black dark hair with subtle strand highlights, muted teal scarf, ivory woven tunic, rust red sash, weathered dark leather bracers and boots with gold-brown bindings, dark blue-black asymmetrical shoulder armor with restrained antique-gold edges and rivets, and subtle cloud embroidery on charcoal trousers. Repaint the FIRST image's surface with this rich, crisp hand-painted game-character texture detail, maintaining broad readable value groups and controlled highlights. Correct the black band over the eyes into actual eyes; correct the solid beard blob into fine natural stubble. This is a texture projection guide that must fit the existing 3D mesh, not a new concept pose. Use evenly lit painted base colors with gentle painted form shading, no strong external light, no rim lighting, no glossy plastic or metal glare. Pure white background. One single front-facing full-body man, no extra objects, no sword, no text, no panels. Match the first image's 2:3 portrait framing and exact pose. Favor preserving the first image's body and costume silhouette over the second image's slightly different pose.
prompts.left: Use case: style-transfer. Texture projection guide for an actual 3D character. Image 1 is the EDIT TARGET and absolute geometry/camera constraint: exact full body left profile facing RIGHT, exact silhouette, A-pose, arm/hand/foot locations, garment boundaries, hair mass, original canvas framing. Image 2 is the supporting COLOR AND SURFACE STYLE reference (same character front). Repaint ONLY the existing surfaces of image 1 with the crisp sophisticated hand-painted game character texture style of image 2: rich muted teal scarf with subtle woven decoration, warm ivory cloth with readable brushed folds and seams, deep charcoal blue trousers with restrained cloud embroidery near knee, reddish rust sash, warm brown leather wrist and boot bindings, healthy warm skin, carefully drawn eyes in visible profile and fine dark stubble beard, deep black detailed hair strands. Preserve exact outlines and geometry of image 1; do not add armor to the bare shoulder on this visible side. Do not change pose or viewpoint; strict orthographic side profile facing RIGHT. Clean white background, full body within frame, 2:3 portrait, no text, no panels, no cast shadow. Lighting is neutral painted shading with no specular glare, no black eye band. This is a texture guide to bake back onto a mesh, so exact alignment is critical.
